name: unit_price_compare
description: Compare the price per unit of several offers with different sizes and units (g, kg, oz, lb; ml, l, US and imperial fl oz, pints, gallons; items and dozens), multipacks and deals such as "3 for 2", "2 for 5.00", "buy 2 get 1 free" or percent off: ranks them, names the cheapest per unit and what each other offer costs extra. Decimal arithmetic with exact NIST unit factors from a bundled dated table.

price.description: Price of one pack as sold

size.description: Quantity in one item of the pack

unit.description: g, kg, mg, oz, lb, ml, cl, dl, l, fl_oz, pt, qt, gal, uk_fl_oz, uk_pint, uk_gal, count, dozen (and aliases)

deal.description: "3 for 2", "2 for 5.00", "buy 2 get 1 free", "bogo", {buy, pay_for} or {buy, total_price}

per.description: Unit of the unit price, with an optional amount: "kg", "100 g", "l" (default kg, l or count)

list_units.description: List the bundled units and their sources

catalog.source: original; unit factors from NIST SP 811 (2008) App. B.8 and NIST Handbook 44 App. C (avoirdupois pound 0.45359237 kg, US gallon 231 in^3, imperial gallon 4.54609 L)
